remarks: BUYER DID NOT PERFORM - OPPORTUNITY IS BACK!!! Welcome to this well-maintained 3-Family home in Shippan Point! It is an opportunity to own, live and/or rent in one of Stamford's desired neighborhoods! This house includes 3 individual units: Main Level has 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, living room with bay window and oversized eat-in kitchen. Laundry room is off of the kitchen with washer/dryer and storage and back door gives access to a full-size deck. This unit has tile/carpeting. This unit is freshly-painted, professionally cleaned and ready to rent or live in! (Carpets are scheduled to be professionally cleaned as well!) Upper Level also has 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, living room with bay window and oversized eat-in kitchen. Upper level has hardwood floors throughout and access to a small back deck. Convenience is key with a laundry room off of kitchen and off-street parking. Lower Level is a 1-bedroom, 1-bath unit with living room/dining area/kitchen combination. This unit does not have a washer/dryer, but does have access to the level backyard. Garage is attached to this unit. Parking is not an issue since there is a paved driveway and a 1-car garage. This property is being sold "AS IS".
